title: The Trump-Xi Summit Exposed the Problems in China-US Crisis Management
author: Yang Jialin
text:
U.S. President Donald Trump salutes during the playing of the U.S. national anthem at a welcome ceremony for Chinese President Xi Jinping (left), Sep. 23, 2026.
Credit: Official White House Photo by Daniel Torok
Xi Jinping’s September visit to Washington ended without a major breakthrough on trade or artificial intelligence safety. Most media coverage focused on the ceremony and the limited results. The official accounts, however, raised important questions about crisis management, which has gone largely undiscussed. China’s readout said the two militaries had “agreed to sign a memorandum of understanding as soon as possible on strengthening crisis communication and prevention.” The White House “fact sheet” did not mention that commitment. A later South China Morning Post report said a U.S. official denied that the discussion had taken place. [...]
